info.acc1: This portal aims to meet the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW) and WCAG 2.1 level AA.
info.acc2: Use the A-, A and A+ buttons at the top of every page to change the text size, and the Theme button for light or dark display.
info.acc3: All pages work with a keyboard. Use Skip to main content to jump past the menus. Images and charts have text alternatives.
info.acc4: Complaints can be spoken instead of typed, and answers can be read aloud, in supported browsers.
info.acc5: If you face any difficulty using this portal, call the helpline {helpline}.
info.help1: How do I sign in? Citizens sign in with their mobile number and a one-time code. Department staff use their user ID and password.
info.help2: How do I register a complaint? Select Register complaint, describe the problem (type or speak), mark the place on the map and submit.
info.help3: Who handles my complaint? It is assigned automatically to the responsible department officer, whose name and designation are shown to you.
info.help4: How long will it take? Each priority has a target time. Overdue complaints are escalated automatically to senior officers.
info.help5: What if I am not satisfied? When a complaint is marked resolved you can confirm it or reopen it with a reason.
info.terms1: Use this portal only to report genuine civic grievances and to access public services.
info.terms2: Do not submit false, abusive or emergency information. In an emergency call 112.
info.terms3: Information about schemes is guidance only; the decision of the sanctioning authority is final.
info.terms4: Your data is processed as described in the privacy policy.
